verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወቅር ፡ ለከ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ ዘእብን ፡ በከመ ፡ ቀዳምያት ፡ ወዕረግ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወእጽሕፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቶን ፡ ጽላት ፡ ዝክተ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ዘሀሎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቀዳምያት ፡ ጽላት ፡ እለ ፡
                  ቀጥቀጥከ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Hew for thyself two tables of stone, as also the first were, and come up to me to the mountain; and I will write upon the tables the words, which were on the first tables, which thou brokest.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Hew for thyself two tables of stone, as also the first were, and come up to me to the mountain; and I will write upon the tables the words, which were on the first tables, which thou brokest.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Moise: "Ciopleşte două table de piatră, ca cele dintâi, şi suie-te la Mine în munte şi voi scrie pe aceste table cuvintele care au fost scrise pe tablele cele dintâi, pe care le-ai sfărâmat.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λαξευσον σεαυτῷ δύο πλάκας λιθίνας, καθὼς καὶ αἱ πρῶται, καὶ ἀνάβηθι πρὸς μὲ εἰς τὸ ὄρος, καὶ γράψω ἐπὶ τῶν πλακῶν τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἦν ἐν ταῖς πλαξὶ ταῖς πρώταις, αἷς συνέτριψας.

verses.geez: ወኩን ፡ ድልወ ፡ ለነግህ ፡ ወተዐርግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ወቁመኒ ፡ ህየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ደብር ።
verses.translation: And be ready by the morning, and thou shalt go up to the mount Sina, and shalt stand there for me on the top of the mountain.

translations.lxx: And be ready by the morning, and thou shalt go up to the mount Sina, and shalt stand there for me on the top of the mountain.
translations.kjv: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
translations.ron: Să fii gata dis-de-dimineaţă şi dimineaţă să te sui în Muntele Sinai şi să stai înaintea Mea acolo pe vârful muntelui.
translations.grk: Καὶ γίνου ἕτοιμος εἰς τὸ πρωί, καὶ ἀναβήσῃ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινά, καὶ στήσῃ μοι ἐκεῖ ἐπʼ ἄκρου τοῦ ὄρους.

verses.geez:
ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየዐርግ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየሀሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደብሩ ፡ ወአባግዕኒ ፡ ወአልህምትኒ ፡ ኢይትረዐዩ
                  ፡ ቅሩቦ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ደብር ።
verses.translation: And let no one go up with thee, nor be seen in all the mountain; and let not the sheep and oxen feed near that mountain.

translations.lxx: And let no one go up with thee, nor be seen in all the mountain; and let not the sheep and oxen feed near that mountain.
translations.kjv: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
translations.ron: Dar nimeni să nu se suie cu tine, nici să se arate în tot muntele: nici oi, nici vite mari să nu pască împrejurul acestui munte".
translations.grk: Καὶ μηδεὶς ἀναβήτω μετὰ σοῦ μηδὲ ὀφθήτω ἐν παντὶ τῷ ὄρει· καὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ βόες μὴ νεμέσθωσαν πλησίον τοῦ ὄρους ἐκείνου.

verses.geez:
ወወቀረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ እለ ፡ እብን ፡ በከመ ፡ ቀዳምያት ፡ ወጌሠ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ወዐርገ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ እልክተ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ እለ ፡ እብን ።
verses.translation: And Moses hewed two tables of stone, as also the first were; and Moses having arisen early, went up to the mount Sina, as the Lord appointed him; and Moses took the two tables of stone.

translations.lxx: And Moses hewed two tables of stone, as also the first were; and Moses having arisen early, went up to the mount Sina, as the Lord appointed him; and Moses took the two tables of stone.
translations.kjv: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
translations.ron: Deci a cioplit Moise două table de piatră, asemenea cu cele dintâi, şi, sculându-se dis-de-dimineaţă, a luat Moise în mâini cele două table de piatră şi s-a suit în Muntele Sinai, cum îi poruncise Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάξευσε δύο πλάκας λιθίνας, καθάπερ καὶ αἱ πρῶται· καὶ ὀρθρίσας Μωυσῆς, ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινὰ, καθότι συνέταξεν αὐτῷ Κύριος· καὶ ἔλαβε Μωυσῆς τὰς δύο πλάκας τὰς λιθίνας.

verses.geez: ወወረደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በደመና ፡ ወቆመ ፡ ህየ ፡ ወጸወዐ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚእ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord descended in a cloud, and stood near him there, and called by the name of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And the Lord descended in a cloud, and stood near him there, and called by the name of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
translations.ron: Atunci S-a pogorât Domnul în nor, a stat acolo şi a rostit numele lui Iahve.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβη Κύριος ἐν νεφέλῃ, καὶ παρέστη αὐτῷ ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἐκάλεσε τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወኀለፈ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ እንተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ወስምየ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል ፡ ርኁቀ ፡
                  መዐት ፡ ወብዙኀ ፡ ምሕረት ፡ ወጻድቅ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord passed by before his face, and proclaimed, The Lord God, pitiful and merciful, longsuffering and very compassionate, and true,

translations.lxx: And the Lord passed by before his face, and proclaimed, The Lord God, pitiful and merciful, longsuffering and very compassionate, and true,
translations.kjv: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
translations.ron: Şi Domnul, trecând pe dinaintea lui, a zis: "Iahve, Iahve, Dumnezeu, iubitor da oameni, milostiv, îndelung-răbdător, plin de îndurare şi de dreptate,
translations.grk: Καὶ παρῆλθε Κύριος πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκάλεσε κύριος ὁ Θεὸς οἰκτείρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων, μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινός,

verses.geez:
ዘየዐቅባ ፡ ለጽድቅ ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ምሕረተ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አእላፍ ፡ ዘያሴስል ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ወጌጋየ ፡ ወኀጢአተ ፡ ወለመአብስ
                  ፡ ኢያነጽሖ ፡ ዘያገብእ ፡ ኀጣውአ ፡ አበው ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ውሉድ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ውሉድ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሣልስት ፡ ወራብዕት ፡
                  ትውልድ ።
verses.translation: and keeping justice and mercy for thousands, taking away iniquity, and unrighteousness, and sins; and he will not clear the guilty; bringing the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and to the children's children, to the third and fourth generation.

translations.lxx: and keeping justice and mercy for thousands, taking away iniquity, and unrighteousness, and sins; and he will not clear the guilty; bringing the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and to the children's children, to the third and fourth generation.
translations.kjv: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
translations.ron: Care păzeşte adevărul şi arată milă la mii de neamuri; Care iartă vina şi răzvrătirea şi păcatul, dar nu lasă nepedepsit pe cel ce păcătuieşte; Care pentru păcatele părinţilor pedepseşte pe copii şi pe copiii copiilor până la al treilea şi al patrulea neam!"
translations.grk: καὶ δικαιοσύνην διατηρῶν καὶ ἔλεος εἰς χιλιάδας, ἀφαιρῶν ἀνομίας καὶ ἀδικίας καὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ οὐ καθαριεῖ τὸν ἔνοχον, ἐπάγων ἀνομίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἐπὶ τέκνα τέκνων ἐπὶ τρίτην καὶ τετάρτην γενεάν.

verses.geez: ወጐጕአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወደነነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses hasted, and bowed to the earth and worshipped;

translations.lxx: And Moses hasted, and bowed to the earth and worshipped;
translations.kjv: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
translations.ron: Atunci a căzut Moise îndată la pământ şi s-a închinat lui Dumnezeu,
translations.grk: Καὶ σπεύσας Μωσῆς κύψας ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν προσεκύνησε·

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ይሑር ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡
                  ጽኑዐ ፡ ክሳድ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወተኀድግ ፡ አንተ ፡ ኀጣውኦ ፡ ወአበሳሁ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ፡ ወንከውን ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: and said, If I have found grace before thee, let my Lord go with us; for the people is stiff-necked: and thou shalt take away our sins and our iniquities, and we will be thine.

translations.lxx: and said, If I have found grace before thee, let my Lord go with us; for the people is stiff-necked: and thou shalt take away our sins and our iniquities, and we will be thine.
translations.kjv: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
translations.ron: Zicând: "De am aflat bunăvoinţă în ochii Tăi, Stăpâne, să meargă Stăpânul în mijlocul nostru, căci poporul acesta e îndărătnic; dar, iartă nelegiuirile noastre şi păcatele şi ne fă moştenirea Ta!"
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπεν, εἰ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐνώπιόν σου, συμπορευθήτω ὁ Κύριός μου μεθʼ ἡμῶν· ὁ λαὸς γὰρ σκληροτράχηλός ἐστι, καὶ ἀφελεῖς σὺ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, καὶ τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν, καὶ ἐσόμεθά σοι.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ እሠይም ፡ ለከ ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ ወእግብር ፡
                  ዐቢያተ ፡ ወክቡራተ ፡ ዘኢኮነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወይሬኢ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ለእለ ፡
                  ውስቴቶሙ ፡ ሀሎከ ፡ ግብሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ መድምም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እገብር ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, I establish a covenant for thee in the presence of all thy people; I will do glorious things, which have not been done in all the earth, or in any nation; and all the people among whom thou art shall see the works of the Lord, that they are wonderful, which I will do for thee.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, I establish a covenant for thee in the presence of all thy people; I will do glorious things, which have not been done in all the earth, or in any nation; and all the people among whom thou art shall see the works of the Lord, that they are wonderful, which I will do for thee.
translations.kjv: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
translations.ron: Domnul însă a zis către Moise: "Iată, Eu închei legământ înaintea a tot poporul tău: Voi face lucruri slăvite, cum n-au fost în tot pământul şi la toate popoarele; şi tot poporul în mijlocul căruia te vei afla tu, va vedea lucrurile Domnului, căci înfricoşător va fi ceea ce voi face pentru tine.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, Ἰδοὺ, ἐγὼ τίθημί σοι διαθήκην ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ σοῦ, ποιήσω ἔνδοξα, ἃ οὐ γέγονεν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ, καὶ ἐν παντὶ ἔθνει· καὶ ὄψεται πᾶς ὁ λαὸς, ἐν οἷς εἶ σὺ, τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου, ὅτι θαυμαστά ἐστιν, ἃ ἐγὼ ποιήσω σοι.

verses.geez:
ወዑቅ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ አንተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ናህ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣወፅኦሙ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽክሙ ፡ ለአሞሬዎን ፡
                  ወለከናኔዎን ፡ ወለኬጤዎን ፡ ወለፌሬዜዎን ፡ ወለሔዌዎን ፡ ወለ[ኢ]ያቡሴዎን ።
verses.translation: Do thou take heed to all things whatsoever I command thee: behold, I cast out before your face the Amorite and the Chananite and the Pherezite, and the Chettite, and Evite, and Gergesite and Jebusite:

translations.lxx: Do thou take heed to all things whatsoever I command thee: behold, I cast out before your face the Amorite and the Chananite and the Pherezite, and the Chettite, and Evite, and Gergesite and Jebusite:
translations.kjv: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
translations.ron: Păstrează ceea ce îţi poruncesc Eu acum: Iată Eu voi izgoni de la faţa ta pe Amorei, pe Canaanei, pe Hetei, pe Ferezei, pe Hevei, pe Gherghesei şi pe Iebusei.
translations.grk: Πρόσεχε σὺ πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι· ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν τὸν Ἀμοῤῥαῖον, καὶ Χαναναῖον, καὶ Φερεζαῖον, καὶ Χετταῖον, καὶ Εὑαῖον, καὶ Γεργεσαῖον, καὶ Ἰεβουσαῖον.

verses.geez:
ዑቅ ፡ እንከ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትትማሐሉ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ እለ ፡ ይተርፉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡
                  እንተ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ትበውኡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይኩን ፡ ጌጋይ ፡ ላዕሌክሙ ።
verses.translation: take heed to thyself, lest at any time thou make a covenant with the dwellers on the land, into which thou art entering, lest it be to thee a stumbling-block among you.

translations.lxx: take heed to thyself, lest at any time thou make a covenant with the dwellers on the land, into which thou art entering, lest it be to thee a stumbling-block among you.
translations.kjv: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
translations.ron: Fereşte-te să intri în legătură cu locuitorii ţării aceleia, în care ai să intri, ca să nu fie ei o cursă între voi.
translations.grk: Πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ, μή ποτε θῇς διαθήκην τοῖς ἐγκαθημένοις ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ εἰς αὐτὴν, μή σοι γένηται πρόσκομμα ἐν ὑμῖν.

verses.geez: ምሥዋዓቲሆሙ ፡ ትነሥቱ ፡ ወምሰሊሆሙ ፡ ትሴበሩ ፡ ወአእዋሞሙ ፡ ትገዝሙ ፡ ወግልፎ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ታውዕዩ ፡ በእሳት ።
verses.translation: Ye shall destroy their altars, and break in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their groves, and the graven images of their gods ye shall burn with fire.

translations.lxx: Ye shall destroy their altars, and break in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their groves, and the graven images of their gods ye shall burn with fire.
translations.kjv: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
translations.ron: Jertfelnicele lor să le stricaţi, stâlpii lor să-i sfărâmaţi; să tăiaţi dumbrăvile lor cele sfinţite şi dumnezeii lor cei ciopliţi să-i ardeţi în foc,
translations.grk: Τοὺς βωμοὺς αὐτῶν καθελεῖτε, καὶ τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν συντρίψετε, καὶ τὰ ἄλση αὐτῶν ἐκκόψετε, καὶ τὰ γλυπτὰ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν κατακαύσετε ἐν πυρί.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ኢትሰግዱ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ አምላክ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቀናጺ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ወእግዚአብሔርሰ ፡ ቀናኢ ፡
                  ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: For ye shall not worship strange gods, for the Lord God, a jealous name, is a jealous God;

translations.lxx: For ye shall not worship strange gods, for the Lord God, a jealous name, is a jealous God;
translations.kjv: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
translations.ron: Căci tu nu trebuie să te închini la alt dumnezeu, fără numai Domnului Dumnezeu, pentru că numele Lui este "Zelosul"; Dumnezeu este zelos.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ μὴ προσκυνήσητε θεοῖς ἑτέροις· ὁ γὰρ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς, ζηλωτὸν ὄνομα, Θεὸς ζηλωτής ἐστι.

verses.geez:
ዮጊ ፡ ትትማሐል ፡ ምስለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወይዜምዉ ፡ ድኅረ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ወይሠውዑ
                  ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ወይጼውዑከ ፡ ወትበልዕ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕቶሙ ።
verses.translation: lest at any time thou make a covenant with the dwellers on the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and they call thee, and thou shouldest eat of their feasts,

translations.lxx: lest at any time thou make a covenant with the dwellers on the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and they call thee, and thou shouldest eat of their feasts,
translations.kjv: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
translations.ron: Nu cumva să intri în legătură cu locuitorii ţării aceleia, pentru că ei, urmând după dumnezeii lor şi aducând jertfe dumnezeilor lor, te vor pofti şi pe tine să guşti din jertfa lor.
translations.grk: Μή ποτε θῇς διαθήκην τοῖς ἔγκαθημένοις ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἐκπορνεύσωσιν ὀπίσω τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ θύσωσι τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ καλέσωσίν σε, καὶ φάγῃς τῶν αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
ወትነሥእ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አዋልዲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቅከ ፡ ወአዋልዲከ ፡ ትሁብ ፡ ለደቂቆሙ ፡ ወይዜምዋ ፡ አዋልዲከ ፡ ድኅረ ፡
                  አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ወያዜምውዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቅከ ፡ ድኅረ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: and thou shouldest take of their daughters to thy sons, and thou shouldest give of thy daughters to their sons; and thy daughters should go a whoring after their gods, and thy sons should go a whoring after their gods.

translations.lxx: and thou shouldest take of their daughters to thy sons, and thou shouldest give of thy daughters to their sons; and thy daughters should go a whoring after their gods, and thy sons should go a whoring after their gods.
translations.kjv: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
translations.ron: Şi vei lua fetele lor soţii pentru fiii tăi şi fetele tale le vei mărita după feciorii lor; şi vor merge fetele tale după dumnezeii lor şi fiii tăi vor merge după dumnezeii lor.
translations.grk: καὶ λάβῃς τῶν θυγατέρων αὐτῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς σου, καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων σου δῷς τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐκπορνεύσωσιν αἱ θυγατέρες σου ὀπίσω τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐκπορνεύσωσιν οἱ υἱοί σου ὀπίσω τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወአማልክተ ፡ ዘስብኮ ፡ ኢትግበር ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt not make to thyself molten gods.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt not make to thyself molten gods.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
translations.ron: Să nu-ţi faci dumnezei turnaţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ θεοὺς χωνευτοὺς οὐ ποιήσεις σεαυτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወሕገ ፡ ናእት ፡ ዕቀብ ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ብላዕ ፡ ናእተ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዝኩከ ፡ በዘመኑ ፡ በወርኀ ፡ ሚያዝያ ፡
                  እስመ ፡ በወርኀ ፡ ሚያዝያ ፡ ወፃእከ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, as I have charged thee, at the season in the month of new corn; for in the month of new corn thou camest out from Egypt.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, as I have charged thee, at the season in the month of new corn; for in the month of new corn thou camest out from Egypt.
translations.kjv: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
translations.ron: Sărbătoarea azimelor să o păzeşti: şapte zile, cum ţi-am poruncit Eu, să mănânci azime, la vremea rânduită în luna Aviv, căci în luna Aviv ai ieşit tu din Egipt.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν ἑσρτὴν τῶν ἀζύμων φυλάξῃ· ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας φαγῃ ἄζυμα, καθάπερ ἐντέταλμαί σοι, εἰς τὸν καιρὸν ἐν μηνὶ τῶν νέων· ἐν γὰρ μηνὶ τῶν νέων ἐξῆλθες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου.

verses.geez: ኵሉ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ ዘይፈትሕ ፡ ማኅፀነ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኵሩ ፡ ለላህም ፡ ወበኵሩ ፡ ለበግዕ ።
verses.translation: The males are mine, everything that opens the womb; every first-born of oxen, and every first-born of sheep.

translations.lxx: The males are mine, everything that opens the womb; every first-born of oxen, and every first-born of sheep.
translations.kjv: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
translations.ron: Tot întâiul născut de parte bărbătească este al Meu; asemenea şi tot întâiul născut al vacii şi tot întâiul născut al oii.
translations.grk: Πᾶν διανοῖγον μήτραν, ἐμοὶ τὰ ἀρσενικὰ, πᾶν πρωτότοκον μόσχου, καὶ πρωτότοκον προβάτου.

verses.geez:
ወበኵሩ ፡ ለአድግ ፡ ወትቤዝዎ ፡ በበግዕ ፡ ወእመሰ ፡ ኢቤዘውካሁ ፡ ሤጦ ፡ ትሁብ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ በኵረ ፡ ውሉድከ ፡ ትቤዙ
                  ፡ ወኢታስተርኢ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ዕራቅከ ።
verses.translation: And the first-born of an ass thou shalt redeem with a sheep, and if thou wilt not redeem it thou shalt pay a price: every first-born of thy sons shalt thou redeem: thou shalt not appear before me empty.

translations.lxx: And the first-born of an ass thou shalt redeem with a sheep, and if thou wilt not redeem it thou shalt pay a price: every first-born of thy sons shalt thou redeem: thou shalt not appear before me empty.
translations.kjv: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
translations.ron: Iar întâiul născut al asinei să-l răscumperi cu un miel, iar de nu-l vei răscumpăra, să-i frângi gâtul. Toţi întâii născuţi din fiii tăi să-i răscumperi şi nimeni să nu se înfăţişeze înaintea Mea cu mâna goală.
translations.grk: Καὶ πρωτότοκον ὑποζυγίου λυτρώσῃ προβάτῳ· ἐὰν δὲ μὴ λυτρώσῃ αὐτὸ, τιμὴν δώσεις. πᾶν πρωτότοκον τῶν υἱῶν σου λυτρώσῃ· οὐκ ὀφθήσῃ ἐνώπιόν μου κενός.

verses.geez: ሰዱሰ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ግብረከ ፡ ወበሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ታዐርፍ ፡ ታዐርፍ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ወታዐርፍ ፡ ዐፂደ ።
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: there shall be rest in seed-time and harvest.

translations.lxx: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: there shall be rest in seed-time and harvest.
translations.kjv: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
translations.ron: Şase zile lucrează, iar în ziua a şaptea să te odihneşti; chiar în vremea semănatului şi a secerişului să te odihneşti.
translations.grk: Ἓξ ἡμέρας ἐργᾷ, τῇ δὲ ἑβδόμῃ καταπαύσεις· τῷ σπόρῳ καὶ τῷ ἀμητῷ κατάπαυσις.

verses.geez: ወበዓለ ፡ ሰንበት ፡ ትገብር ፡ ሊተ ፡ አመ ፡ ይቀድሙ ፡ ዐፂደ ፡ ስርናይ ፡ ወበዓለ ፡ ምኵራብ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዓመት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt keep to me the feast of weeks, the beginning of wheat-harvest; and the feast of ingathering in the middle of the year.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt keep to me the feast of weeks, the beginning of wheat-harvest; and the feast of ingathering in the middle of the year.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
translations.ron: Să ţii şi sărbătoarea săptămânilor, sărbătoarea pârgei, la secerişul grâului, şi sărbătoarea strângerii roadelor, la sfârşitul toamnei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἑορτὴν ἑβδομάδων ποιήσεις μοι, ἀρχὴν θερισμοῦ πυροῦ· καὶ ἐορτὴν συναγωγῆς μεσοῦντος τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ.

verses.geez: ሠለስተ ፡ ዘመነ ፡ ለዓመት ፡ ያስተርኢ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተባዕትከ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: Three times in the year shall every male of thine appear before the Lord the God of Israel.

translations.lxx: Three times in the year shall every male of thine appear before the Lord the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the LORD God, the God of Israel.
translations.ron: De trei ori pe an să se înfăţişeze înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului lui Israel toţi cei de parte bărbătească ai tăi,
translations.grk: Τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ὀφθήσεται πᾶν ἀρσενικόν σου ἐνώπιον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወአመ ፡ አወፅኦሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ወእሰፍሖ ፡ ለአድዋሊከ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይፈትዋ ፡ መኑሂ ፡ ለምድርከ
                  ፡ ወሶበ ፡ ተዐርግ ፡ ታስተርኢ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ ዘመነ ፡ ለዓመት ።
verses.translation: For when I shall have cast out the nations before thy face, and shall have enlarged thy coasts, no one shall desire thy land, whenever thou mayest go up to appear before the Lord thy God, three times in the year.

translations.lxx: For when I shall have cast out the nations before thy face, and shall have enlarged thy coasts, no one shall desire thy land, whenever thou mayest go up to appear before the Lord thy God, three times in the year.
translations.kjv: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
translations.ron: Căci când voi goni popoarele de la faţa ta şi voi lărgi hotarele tale, nimeni nu va pofti ogorul tău, de te vei sui să te înfăţişezi înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului tău de trei ori pe an.
translations.grk: Ὅταν γὰρ ἐκβάλω τὰ ἔθνη πρὸ προσώπου σου, καὶ πλατυνῶ τὰ ὅριά σου, οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσει οὐδεὶς τῆς γῆς σου, ἡνίκα ἂν ἀναβαίνῃς ὀφθῆναι ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ.

verses.geez: ኢትዝባሕ ፡ ብሑአ ፡ ደም ፡ መሥዋዕትየ ፡ ወኢይቢት ፡ ለነግህ ፡ [ዘዘብሑ ፡] ለበዓለ ፡ ፋሲካ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifices with leaven, neither shall the sacrifices of the feast of the passover remain till the morning.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifices with leaven, neither shall the sacrifices of the feast of the passover remain till the morning.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
translations.ron: Să nu torni sângele jertfei Mele pe pâine dospită şi jertfa de la sărbătoarea Paştilor să nu rămână până a doua zi.
translations.grk: Οὐ σφάξεις ἐπὶ ζύμῃ αἷμα θυμιαμάτων μου, καὶ οὐ κοιμηθήσεται εἰς τὸ πρωῒ θύματα ἑορτῆς τοῦ πάσχα.

verses.geez:
ቀዳሜ ፡ እክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ትወስድ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፤ ወኢታብስል ፡ በግዐ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይጠቡ ፡ ሐሊበ
                  ፡ እሙ ።
verses.translation: The first-fruits of thy land shalt thou put into the house of the Lord thy God: thou shalt not boil a lamb in his mother's milk.

translations.lxx: The first-fruits of thy land shalt thou put into the house of the Lord thy God: thou shalt not boil a lamb in his mother's milk.
translations.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
translations.ron: Cele dintâi roade ale ţarinii tale să le aduci în casa Domnului Dumnezeului tău. Să nu fierbi iedul în laptele mamei sale".
translations.grk: Τὰ πρωτογεννήματα τῆς γῆς σου θήσεις εἰς τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου· οὐχ ἑψήσεις ἄρνα ἐν γάλακτι μητρὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ጸሐፍ ፡ ለከ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ነገረ ፡ [እስመ ፡ በዝንቱ ፡ ነገር ፡] ኣቀውም ፡ ለከ ፡
                  ኪዳነ ፡ ወለእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Write these words for thyself, for on these words I have established a covenant with thee and with Israel.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Write these words for thyself, for on these words I have established a covenant with thee and with Israel.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
translations.ron: Şi a mai zis Domnul către Moise: "Scrie-ţi cuvintele acestea, căci pe cuvintele acestea închei Eu legământ cu tine şi cu Israel!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, γράψον σεαυτῷ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα· ἐπὶ γὰρ τῶν λόγων τούτων τέθειμαί σοι διαθήκην, καὶ τῷ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወሀሎ ፡ ህየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፵ዕለተ ፡ ወ፵ሌሊተ ፤ እክለ ፡ ኢበልዐ ፡ ወማየ ፡ ኢሰትየ ፡ ወጸሐፈ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ጽላት ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ፲ቃለ ።
verses.translation: And Moses was there before the Lord forty days, and forty nights; he did not eat bread, and he did not drink water; and he wrote upon the tables these words of the covenant, the ten sayings.

translations.lxx: And Moses was there before the Lord forty days, and forty nights; he did not eat bread, and he did not drink water; and he wrote upon the tables these words of the covenant, the ten sayings.
translations.kjv: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
translations.ron: Moise a stat acolo la Domnul patruzeci de zile şi patruzeci de nopţi; şi nici pâine n-a mâncat, nici apă n-a băut. Şi a scris Moise pe table cuvintele legământului: cele zece porunci.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ Μωυσῆς ἐναντίον Κυρίου τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας, καὶ τεσσεράκοντα νύκτας· ἄρτον οὐκ ἔφαγε, καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἔπιε· καὶ ἔγραψεν ἐπὶ τῶν πλακῶν τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα τῆς διαθήκης, τοὺς δέκα λόγους.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ወረደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እምደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ወሀለዋ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላት ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ ይወርድ
                  ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወኢያእመረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ ሕብረ ፡ ገጹ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትናገር ፡ ምስለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And when Moses went down from the mountain, there were the two tables in the hands of Moses,—as then he went down from the mountain, Moses knew not that the appearance of the skin of his face was glorified, when God spoke to him.

translations.lxx: And when Moses went down from the mountain, there were the two tables in the hands of Moses,—as then he went down from the mountain, Moses knew not that the appearance of the skin of his face was glorified, when God spoke to him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
translations.ron: Iar când se pogora Moise din Muntele Sinai, având în mâini cele două table ale legii, el nu ştia că faţa sa strălucea, pentru că grăise Dumnezeu cu el.
translations.grk: Ὡς δὲ κατέβαινε Μωυσῆς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους, καὶ αἱ δύο πλάκες ἐπὶ τῶν χειρῶν Μωυσῆ· καταβαίνοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους, Μωυσῆς οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι δεδόξασται ἡ ὄψις τοῦ χρώματος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ λαλεῖν αὐτὸν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእይዎ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ ርእየተ ፡ ሕብረ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ፈርሁ
                  ፡ ቀሪቦቶ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the skin of his face was made glorious, and they feared to approach him.

translations.lxx: And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the skin of his face was made glorious, and they feared to approach him.
translations.kjv: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
translations.ron: Deci Aaron şi toţi fiii lui Israel, văzând pe Moise că are faţa strălucitoare, s-au temut să se apropie de el.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδεν Ἀαρὼν καὶ πάντες οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ἰσραὴλ τὸν Μωυσῆν, καὶ ἦν δεδοξασμένη ἡ ὄψις τοῦ χρώματος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν ἐγγίσαι αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወገብኡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መኳንንተ ፡ ተዕይንት ፡ ወነገሮሙ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Moses called them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the synagogue turned towards him, and Moses spoke to them.

translations.lxx: And Moses called them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the synagogue turned towards him, and Moses spoke to them.
translations.kjv: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
translations.ron: Atunci i-a chemat Moise şi au venit la el Aaron şi toate căpeteniile obştei şi Moise a grăit cu ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς, καὶ ἐπεστράφησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἀαρὼν καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς· καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ቀርቡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአዘዞሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘነገሮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  በደብረ ፡ ሱና ።
verses.translation: And afterwards all the children of Israel came to him, and he commanded them all things, whatsoever the Lord had commanded him in the mount of Sina.

translations.lxx: And afterwards all the children of Israel came to him, and he commanded them all things, whatsoever the Lord had commanded him in the mount of Sina.
translations.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
translations.ron: După aceasta s-au apropiat de el toţi fiii lui Israel şi el le-a poruncit tot ce-i grăise Domnul în Muntele Sinai.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα προσῆλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ. καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς πάντα, ὅσα ἐνετείλατο Κύριος πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινά.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ አኅለቀ ፡ ተናግሮቶሙ ፡ ወደየ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ግልባቤ ፡ በዘ ፡ ይሴውር ፡ ገጾ ።
verses.translation: And when he ceased speaking to them, he put a veil on his face.

translations.lxx: And when he ceased speaking to them, he put a veil on his face.
translations.kjv: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a încetat de a grăi cu ei, Moise şi-a acoperit faţa cu un văl.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπειδὴ κατέπαυσε λαλῶν πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ κάλυμμα.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትናገሮ ፡ ያሴስል ፡ ግልባቤሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡
                  ወእምከመ ፡ ወፅአ ፡ ይነግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak to him, he took off the veil till he went out, and he went forth and spoke to all the children of Israel whatsoever the Lord commanded him.

translations.lxx: And whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak to him, he took off the veil till he went out, and he went forth and spoke to all the children of Israel whatsoever the Lord commanded him.
translations.kjv: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
translations.ron: Când însă intra el înaintea Domnului, ca să vorbească cu El, atunci îşi ridica vălul până când ieşea; iar la ieşire spunea fiilor lui Israel cele ce i se porunciseră de către Domnul.
translations.grk: Ἡνίκα δʼ ἂν εἰσεπορεύετο Μωυσῆς, ἔναντι Κυρίου λαλεῖν αὐτῷ, περιῃρεῖτο τὸ κάλυμμα ἕως τοῦ ἐκπορεύεσθαι· καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐλάλει πᾶσι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ ὅσα ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ Κύριος.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ወደየ ፡ ግልባቤ ፡ በዘ ፡ ይሴወር ፡ እስከ
                  ፡ ይ[በው]እ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትናገሮ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it was glorified; and Moses put the veil over his face, till he went in to speak with him.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it was glorified; and Moses put the veil over his face, till he went in to speak with him.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
translations.ron: Şi vedeau fiii lui Israel că fata lui Moise strălucea şi Moise îşi punea iar vălul peste faţa sa, până când intra din nou să vorbească cu Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδον οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὸ πρόσωπον Μωυσέως, ὅτι δεδόξασται· καὶ περιέθηκε Μωυσῆς κάλυμμα ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπον ἑαυτοῦ, ἕως ἂν εἰσέλθῃ συλλαλεῖν αὐτῷ.
